external_observations.label: positive
external_observations.evidence_span: Svai Sauna Google profile: rating 4.3/5, 54 ratings.

external_observations.label: positive
external_observations.evidence_span: We had a lovely time here. I think it best to just book the session where it’s possible for others to join you because it’s much cheaper and tends to just be you there anyway. Not busy at all. So tranquil. It’s basic but it’s all you need. When we went we tried to pluck up the courage to plunge into the cold water outside but there were a lot of jelly fish in July when we went so we decided against it but someone local told us afterwards that we should have as they don’t tend to cause any serious damage if they sting. I’m not convinced. That in itself added some excitement anyway and didn’t detract from the experience. When a lovely place. Basic but everything there that you need and very easy access just past the hotel and down some steps behind the building. (Not through the locked gate you may see there first)

external_observations.label: positive
external_observations.evidence_span: We had a great time here, we shared the sauna with a group of locals who made our time even more enjoyable. The sauna was hot, the water was very cold, great time had by all! The changing space is a little small and the storage isn’t perfect but just come prepared and you’ll be fine! Definitely worth a visit!

external_observations.label: positive
external_observations.evidence_span:
Basically a great idea. We had booked 2 hours exclusively.
Unfortunately, everything is very simple, it looks like made by a handyman with cheap materials, partly unkempt.
For 2500 NOK definitely too expensive.
- No place to sit and change clothes
- Only cold water
- Pictures partly misleading
- There are buildings on two sides, no privacy, Hotel guests observed us.
- Previous guests were not ready in time.
Unfortunately no recommendation!

external_observations.label: positive
external_observations.evidence_span: Sooo good! I paid for a drop in 2hr session today and was the only person there. The door was unlocked, no code needed. Highly recommend coming here and taking a quick dip in between 15 min sauna sessions. So relaxing.

external_observations.label: positive
external_observations.evidence_span: Great sauna - high standard, spacious and clean, nice music system, cold shower, spacious area outside. It would be even better if the temperature was 80 degrees when we came at 10 am and not 64, since it took us 20 min to reach 105. After that everything was absolutely superb!
